observation_format.note: Observation conversion code (water/agents/react.py) not in bundle.

tool_count.note: No default tool set; tools user-supplied. stop_tool=True injects __done__ tool. Code not in bundle.

edit_primitive.note: Tool registry source not in bundle; file I/O tasks exist in water/tasks/io.py but not visible.

tool_schema_source.note: Tools defined with hand-written JSON schema; MCPClient calls external MCP servers.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Expose flows as discoverable A2A agents or call remote agents

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: runs a Think-Act-Observe-Repeat cycle where the LLM decides which tools to call and when to stop
loop_primitives.note: Core is Flow pipelines (sequential/parallel/DAG); PlannerAgent plan_and_execute; EventEmitter subscriptions. No single default.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Let an LLM decompose goals into steps and execute them
planning_granularity.note: PlannerAgent opt-in; plan structure not verified in code.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Create child agents that run their own isolated ReAct loops with separate context windows
multi_agent_topology.note: Default agentic task is single; opt-in orchestrator_workers via sub-agent tools and create_agent_team (sequential/round_robin/dynamic).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Parent agent uses the sub-agent as a regular tool
delegation_mechanism.note: Default none; opt-in subagent_spawn via create_sub_agent_tool; role_handoff via agent teams.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Add human approval checkpoints for high-risk operations
human_in_loop.note: ApprovalGate with ApprovalPolicy(auto_approve_below=RiskLevel...) opt-in; human-in-the-loop tasks in water/agents/human.py.

short_term_state.note: react.py state object not in bundle; README mentions steps/history.

long_term_memory.note: MemoryManager layered memory exists (ORG>PROJECT>USER>SESSION); persistence across runs depends on storage backend not visible in bundle.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Automatically retry failed guardrails with LLM feedback
self_verification.note: LLMJudge evaluator in eval suite; guardrail checks (schema/content) opt-in. Default none.

retry_policy.note: Retries are opt-in task params; RetryWithFeedback(max_retries=3) opt-in fixed_n. Default value not verified.

rollback.note: No undo/snapshot mention; tool/sandbox source not in bundle.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: stop_tool=True, # Inject __done__ tool for explicit stop signaling
termination_condition.note: max_iterations cap; custom stop_condition; CostTracker budget_limit (on_budget_exceeded='warn' shown, stopping unverified).

cost_controls.note: FlowCache result caching; FallbackChain is failover (lowest_latency), not coded as routing.

timeouts.note: Per-task timeout also; run-level timeout not seen.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: from water.agents import create_sandboxed_task, SandboxConfig, SubprocessSandbox
execution_isolation.note: Sandboxed execution is opt-in per task; SubprocessSandbox is shown in the README. Default for ordinary tasks appears in-process; other sandbox backends truncated in excerpt.
